title: Jom Mula
hook: Request-driven tutorials on building real applications, written for people who learn by making.
text: I love to teach, but the best feeling in teaching is when the person is willing to learn. On Jom Mula I write guides on how to build specific applications, based on requests from other people.
highlights: Tutorials written around real requests from readers.
CMS-backed, so new guides ship without touching code.
Teaching as a way of giving knowledge back.

caseStudy.problem: People kept asking how to build the same kinds of applications, and answering one person at a time did not scale.
caseStudy.approach: I turned the requests into written guides: pick a specific application, build it step by step, and publish it where anyone can follow along.
caseStudy.outcome: Jom Mula is live at jom.elysiaa.com as a growing library of build guides.
caseStudy.learned: Writing a tutorial exposes every gap in your own understanding. Teaching is the cheapest code review you can give yourself.
